title: Project browser: send listed sites through a proxy, everything else direct
notes:
User's need: work sites (instacoins.travel, test servers) are reachable only through a VPN the user runs as a local proxy; in Chrome, ZeroOmega sends those hosts through it and everything else direct.

User's design, 2026-11-27: every site goes direct unless the settings file lists it, and the list takes wildcards. For example:
  "browser": { "proxy": { "server": "socks5://127.0.0.1:1080", "hosts": ["*.instacoins.travel", "instacoins.travel", "test-*.internal"] } }
(names are a proposal; settle them in review).

Review first, write no code until main has your design: check Electron's session.setProxy in its docs (pacScript, proxyRules, proxyBypassRules) for the version we ship, and say which one gives direct-by-default with a listed set through the proxy. A generated PAC script from the host list looks right; say if not. Settle: wildcard meaning (does *.x match x itself; * inside a label), HTTP vs SOCKS servers, whether it applies to every project's browser session (partitionOf, src/main/browser/browser-tabs.ts) with a per-project override, applying a settings change without restart, and what a tab shows when the proxy is down. SendMessage main-dashboard the design, then build it: the host matching as a decision module with a test, applied through the browser action, docs/browser and docs/settings updated.

comments.body: Pull request #417 opened: Send the hosts browser.proxy lists through a proxy, every other site direct https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/417

Review loop converged in 3 rounds, CI green on the head commit: ready to merge. Fixed: a hand-written browser.proxy that did not parse is kept across app saves; proxyMoved (apply only on change) is tested; views read the proxy live from main's settings; Reset everything to defaults keeps browser.proxy. Nothing open. Design and scope unchanged.
